newsitem.title: ITALY: Stet-Telecom share exchange ratio to be set soon.
newsitem.headline: Stet-Telecom share exchange ratio to be set soon.

text.p: Italian Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said the share exchange ratio for the merger of state telecoms holding Stet and telephone operator Telecom Italia will be revealed in the next few weeks.

"They are working on the criteria and a decision is near but we can't reveal it yet, this will be in the next few weeks," Ciampi told reporters after addressing the upper house Senate public works commission.
Ciampi earlier confirmed that the planned fusion of Telecom Italia into Stet will be completed by June with the privatisation of the new group taking place by autumn.
Ciampi added that the government had not yet taken a decision on the possible use of a golden share for the sale.
Speculation on the merger exchange ratio has led to recent arbitrage between the two stocks on the Milan stock market.

Some market players have calculated the ratio at more than two Telecom shares for every Stet share, but sector analysts said this would be punitive for Telecom's shareholders and put the exchange ratio at around 1.7 Telecom shares per Stet share.
At 1355 GMT, Telecom Italia was trading at 4,295 lire, up 4.68 percent, and Stet up 2.54 percent at 7,590 in a generally firmer stock market.
